name: GAN12 M MagLev (Matte) 3x3
description: The GAN12 MagLev (Matte) 3x3 is at the very peak of 3x3 innovation and design. This flagship puzzle includes adjustable magnets in the pieces and an adjustable magnetic levitation tension/compression system. This technology utilizes opposing magnets to imitate the feel of a spring while also reducing friction and spring noise. This version has a matte finish out the outer surface.
